title: FRONT CONSOLE & UNDERBODY TUNNEL
summary: Front console (the center console over the transmission tunnel, under the shifter trim plate), all models. The shifter housing and the trim plate sit in the console opening and are held by a screw down through the trim plate into a U-nut on the console; the console's front edge clips over a reinforcement at the dash (View A) and its side is riveted at the front.

parts.name: HOUSING ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Housing assembly – shifter opening under the console trim plate

parts.name: REINFORCEMENT
parts.name_expanded: Reinforcement – front console, at instrument panel

fastening.note: Screw [1] goes down from the top through the corner of the console trim plate and the flange of housing asm. [3] into U-nut [7] clipped on the front console [4] (dash-dot line).
Guide [2] fits into the shift lever slot of housing [3]; no fastener shown.
View A (assembled): the front edge of the console [4] hooks over the flange of reinforcement [6]; dash-dot lines show the reinforcement's holes lining up with the dash and console top.

fastening.to: body at the front of the tunnel
fastening.note: Rivet [5] goes in from the LH side through a hole in the front vertical part of the console [4].
